headline: Invitation Homes (NYSE:INVH) Crushes Q2 Estimates and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Invitation Homes (INVH) smashed Q2 estimates with Core FFO of $0.51 vs $0.178 expected, raised full-year guidance, and accelerated share buybacks amid strong rental demand.

headline: Invitation Homes Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: DALLAS, July 29, 2026--Invitation Homes Inc. (NYSE: INVH) ("Invitation Homes," "we," "our," and "us"), the nation’s premier single-family home leasing and management company, today announced our Second Quarter ("Q2") 2026 financial and operating results.
